tickets.description: Array of ticket objects (when items = tickets)

ticket_events.description: Array of ticket event objects (when items = ticket events)

users.description: Array of user objects (when items = users)

organizations.description: Array of organization objects (when items = organizations)

next_page.description: URL for the next page using the end_time as start_time

end_time.description: Timestamp to use as start_time for the next request

end_of_stream.description: True when the last page of results has been reached

count.description: Number of items on the page (not reliable for pagination)
